'''Jae Doraan''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Cantina" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jae Doraan appears in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', on Nar Shaddaa at the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]]. Doraan is not a vendor and not part of any missions and therefore can't be interacted with.<ref name="Cantina" /> This character was a cameo of Jae Doraan, member of the costuming group Cosplayers of the Old Republic (COTOR).<ref name="cameo">{{WebCite|url=https://todayintor.com/2024/10/07/jae-doraan-cameo-in-swtor/|text=Jae Doraan Cameo in SWTOR|archivedate=20241008025019}}</ref>
